commits.body:
Mechanical setup for llm-dlc/loops/in-the-loop-change-verification-strategy.md, in ~/.cache/in-the-loop/change-verification. It mirrors and checks out both Retrofit pins of compsuite-i-1 and the four Commons IO/CSV commits example 345 builds from. It rebuilds Retrofit's wire module on JDK 8, online and offline, and records ordered runtime and test classpaths. It checks 32 Retrofit-graph artifacts and 130 Spring Boot 2.7.18/3.0.13 jars against Maven Central's SHA-1s and signatures, using its own keyring.

Verified on a JVM: WireConverterFactoryTest passes on Wire 2.2.0 and errors with NoSuchMethodError okio.Utf8.size$default on 3.0.2. A throwaway probe shows the response converter preserving both recorded phones on both sides, while the request converter throws on the new side, as the brief states. validate_example.py 345 --replay passes; its new receipt was moved to the cache and the example left unchanged. The organic recount gives 39/46 strict native and 46/46 finite, and differs from the stored scorecard only by the later JavaParser receipt. No claims, examples, adapters or library changes were made, and no verification job was needed.
